item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\n\\ndef check(req,pol,expected):\\n    r0=copy.deepcopy(req); p0=copy.deepcopy(pol)\\n    got=evaluate(req,pol)\\n    assert got==expected,(got,expected)\\n    assert req==r0 and pol==p0\\n    assert set(got)=={'ok','value','reason'}\\n\\np={'edges':{'a>b':{},'b>c':{'role':'op'},'c>d':{'role':'op','retry':True},'d>e':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2}\\ncheck({'from':'x','to':'y'},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'})\\ncheck({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'bad'},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'})\\ncheck({'from':'c','to':'d','role':'bad','attempts':0},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'})\\ncheck({'from':'c','to':'d','role':'op','attempts':0},p,{'ok':True,'value':'d','reason':'ok'})\\nfor attempts in (True,False,None,-1,2,3,1.0,'1'):\\n check({'from':'d','to':'e','attempts':attempts},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'})\\ncheck({'from':'d','to':'e','attempts':1},p,{'ok':True,'value':'e','reason':'ok'})\\nwith open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)\\nwith open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nassert report==[evaluate(req,policy) for req in requests]\\nwith open('OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json') as f: schema=json.load(f)\\nfor item in report:\\n assert set(item)==set(schema['required'])\\n assert isinstance(item['ok'],bool)\\n assert item['value'] is None or isinstance(item['value'],str)\\n assert item['reason'] in schema['properties']['reason']['enum']\\nprint('all checks passed')\"]}"}
